metas.name: ★ 7.5 · 2025 · Aka Charlie Sheen
metas.description: After 7 years sober, Charlie Sheen candidly discusses his rise to fame and public downfall, joined by family and friends who share untold stories of his journey through stardom, struggles, and redemption.

metas.name: ★ 6.7 · 2025 · Amy Bradley Is Missing
metas.description: March 24, 1998, Amy Lynn Bradley, 23, is enjoying a family cruise vacation when Amy suddenly vanishes without a trace. This twist-filled 3-part documentary mystery explores the theories, and a family's desperate search for the truth.

metas.name: ★ 7.6 · 2026 · Trust Me: The False Prophet
metas.description: A cult expert and her videographer husband embed themselves in a vulnerable FLDS community, where they discover disturbing evidence about Samuel Bateman, who claims to be the successor to imprisoned prophet Warren Jeffs.

metas.name: ★ 7.1 · 2025 · Gone Girls: The Long Island Serial Killer
metas.description: A look back at the women who disappeared from New York City and Long Island before the 2010 discovery of female remains found in the Gilgo Beach area of Long Island, which lead authorities to believe the deaths were all connected.

metas.name: ★ 6.4 · 2025 · Jerry Springer: Fights, Camera, Action
metas.description: Jaw-dropping documentary goes behind the scenes of America's most controversial talk show to expose its biggest scandals, both on- and off-camera.
